title: Doubly Robust Estimation of Treatment Effects in Staggered Difference-in-Differences with Time-Varying Covariates
abstract: arXiv:2603.04080v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The difference-in-differences (DiD) design is a quasi-experimental method for estimating treatment effects from panel data. With staggered adoption, the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) is defined at the group-period level and aggregated into groupwise, periodwise, dynamic, and overall estimands. Existing doubly robust estimators typically compare treated groups to a single reference group and do not account for differing variability across multiple not-yet-treated cohorts. We propose an augmented inverse variance weighting (AIVW) estimator that pools information across all available not-yet-treated groups using conditional-variance weights, extending this approach to settings with time-varying covariates under an explicit covariate-exogeneity condition. Under a homoskedastic working model, AIVW reduces to an augmented inverse probability weighting (AIPW) estimator that is simpler to compute and more robust in fini

translated_title: 含时变协变量的交错双重差分中处理效应的双鲁棒估计
translated_abstract: 差分中的差分（DiD）设计是一种从面板数据中估计处理效应的准实验方法。在交错采纳的情形下，处理组的平均处理效应（ATT）在组-期水平上定义，并可聚合为分组、分期、动态和总体估计量。现有的双鲁棒估计量通常将处理组与单一参考组进行比较，且未考虑多个尚未处理组之间变异性的差异。我们提出了一种增强逆方差加权估计量，该估计量利用条件方差权重汇集所有可用的尚未处理组的信息，并在显式的协变量外生性条件下将该方法扩展到含时变协变量的情形。在同方差工作模型下，AIVW 可简化为增强逆概率加权估计量，该估计量计算更简单，且在有限样本中更加稳健。
tldr: 提出了一种增强逆方差加权估计量，通过条件方差权重汇集所有尚未处理组的信息，实现了含时变协变量的交错双重差分中处理效应的双鲁棒估计。
en_tdlr: We propose an augmented inverse variance weighting (AIVW) estimator that pools information across all not-yet-treated groups using conditional-variance weights, achieving doubly robust estimation of treatment effects in staggered difference-in-differences with time-varying covariates.
